## Requirements (from the ticket)

1. `Provider` interface + registry — `discover / fetch / changeKey`; discovery emits rows
   only (zero body-endpoint calls, asserted) (REQ-INGEST-2/3).
2. Five MVP providers: Substack public API (archive → items w/ `access`; paywalled → export
   CTA, never fetched; `/feed` fallback; `updated_at`→body-hash changeKey), Substack export
   zip (`posts.csv` + `posts/*.html`), single URL (Readability-class; ETag/Last-Modified→body
   hash; paywall → `partial` + note), upload, paste (connections without discovery —
   REQ-INGEST-1).
3. Link-a-publication flow: handle → SSRF-validated → `discover()` only → review (free
   included default; paid/unknown omitted w/ export CTA) → Confirm → fetch ≤1 req/s, honest
   UA, robots → canonical Markdown → Sample v1. Connection + items persist before first fetch
   (REQ-INGEST-3/5/12).
4. Samples tab: sources pane (status, last sync, error+remedy, Re-sync, remove) + items pane
   (include/omit retaining bytes, quality badge, ★ held-out post-calibration, "changed since
   profile" line) + corpus summary + filter/sort (REQ-INGEST-4 surface).
5. Re-sync + diffing: manual default; optional daily auto-sync that never auto-includes
   (`state:'new'`); diff by `externalId` → `new`/`removed_remote`(kept, badged, still
   included)/changed → conditional re-fetch → new `sample_versions` row ONLY on normalized
   body-hash change (AC-I-A); verbatim provider error + remedy; last-good retained
   (REQ-INGEST-6/11).
6. PDF pipeline: five verdicts `clean`/`reconstructed`/`partial`/`unreadable`/`empty`;
   non-clean → quality drawer (side-by-side raw vs Markdown, *Re-convert with visual* ≈180 cr
   estimate+cap before consent, *Omit*); ≈4 cr reconstruction pass priced before it runs;
   scans route through OCR (GCP document-OCR — Textract substituted per the GCP-first
   amendment); visual tier never automatic, never inside convert (REQ-INGEST-7/8/9).
7. Canonical Markdown: front-matter (title/date/source URL/fetched-at/hashes/quality),
   `[^n]` footnotes, content-addressed images, no body H1; read-only preview + version
   history; an "edit" creates a different piece (REQ-INGEST-10).
8. Formats + caps: `.md .txt .docx .doc .pages .rtf .odt .epub .html .pdf .png .jpg .tiff`;
   25 MB/file, 200k words/sample, 50 files/batch; enforced server-side on sniffed type;
   over-cap files listed + auto-omitted + counted against coverage (REQ-INGEST-8).
9. Never-cookies (AC-I-B): CI grep over ingestion UI / connections schema surface / OpenAPI /
   client bundle — no cookie/session-token field, header, or form input; Substack fixtures
   carry no `Cookie` header; `auth_ref` stays unused at MVP (REQ-INGEST-5).
10. Deletion: deleting a voice cascades samples + raw bytes + profile within the retention
    window via `apps/worker/src/deletion.ts`; forked house-style samples are references
    (no double-delete) (REQ-INGEST-14 half).

## Plan

- **NEW `packages/ingest`** (`@rhema/ingest`): pure-TS provider framework — `Provider`
  interface, registry, FetchPort (injected; bound upstream to the operator-owned fetcher
  service — providers never see a credential), ConvertPort, BlobPort; the five providers;
  `sync.ts` diff/sync engine (ports for store/fetch/convert so it's deterministically
  testable); `caps.ts`; `canonical.ts` (assembleImportedDoc + footnote `[^n]` normalization +
  content-addressed images + no-body-H1). New deps: `jszip` (MIT, already in tree) for the
  export zip; `fast-xml-parser` (MIT, already in tree transitively) for `/feed`.
- **apps/convert**: `convertPdf` extraction heuristics → `partial` verdicts + scan/OCR
  quality-note; stays no-network (the LLM passes are worker jobs).
- **migration 0035**: `personas.deleted_at` (voice tombstone for the retention-window purge).
- **apps/api**: `ingest-routes.ts` — POST /voices/:id/connections (discover+persist, no body
  fetch), POST …/sync (enqueue `ingest.sync`), DELETE …/connections/:cid,
  PATCH …/connections/:cid (auto_include_new/schedule), GET samples/:itemId (read-only
  preview + versions + drawer data), GET …/raw (raw bytes for the side-by-side),
  POST …/reconstruct (≈4 cr) + …/revisual (≈180 cr, consent-gated), POST …/connections/import
  (export zip via quarantine), DELETE /voices/:id (tombstone + voice.purge). Corpus queries
  widen `state='included'` → `('included','removed_remote')` (removed-remote stays in corpus).
- **apps/worker**: `ingest-jobs.ts` (`ingest.sync` / `ingest.reconstruct` / `ingest.revisual`),
  `voice.purge` handler + `deletion.ts` voice-purge policy, main.ts registrations + daily
  sweep cron.
- **apps/web + api-client**: Samples tab rework (sources pane, items pane w/ badges +
  filter/sort, corpus summary, Add menu incl. Link publication + export zip), item preview
  page (read-only markdown + version history + quality drawer), DTOs + methods.
- **scripts/check-no-cookies.mjs** + `pnpm check:no-cookies` + CI `public-safe` step.

## Evidence report

**What landed (Stage A, complete):** the full §9.5 MVP framework — `@rhema/ingest` with a
credential-free `Provider` interface (`discover`/`fetch`/`changeKey` over injected ports;
there is structurally no field for a cookie/session/key), five providers (Substack public
API + `/feed` fallback + export zip, single URL, upload, paste), the confirm-gated
discover→sync engine with `new`/`removed_remote`/changed diffing and AC-I-A deduplication,
the Samples tab (sources/items/drawer/preview/version history), the five-verdict PDF
pipeline with priced `reconstruct` (≈4 cr) and consent-gated `revisual` (≈180 cr) worker
jobs, canonical Markdown (`assembleImportedDoc`, `[^n]` footnotes, content-addressed
images, no body H1), sniffed-type caps, the AC-I-B CI gate, and tombstone→purge voice
deletion with fork-reference survival.

**Prior-worker changes retained:** all of them — the interrupted run had landed the package,
routes, jobs, surfaces, migration, and tests; this run audited them (never-cookies clean,
all remote bytes through the FetchPort seam, visual tier opt-in only) and **closed the four
integration gaps** it left: (1) the AC-I-B CI gate file/script/step now exists;
(2) `worker/main.ts` now registers `ingest.sync`/`ingest.reconstruct`/`voice.purge`
consumers + the daily `ingest.sync.sweep` cron with honest fail-closed seams;
(3) the fetcher allowlist now admits RSS/XML so the `/feed` fallback works live;
(4) api+worker → fetcher `FetchPort` (`createFetcherServicePort`, OIDC-gated like the
export service) + `createGcsBlobStore` + convert-Job + `AnthropicReconstructor` bindings
with the Pulumi env/IaC to match. In-run fixes from the prior thread kept: unused-var
lints, the Hono repeated-form-field parse fix (all-fields), `INGEST_JOB_NAMES` naming.

**OCR substitution (spec note):** the spec's "scans add Textract" predates the GCP-first
amendment. The substitution: `scanned_pdf`/`unreadable` verdicts route to the **visual
tier**, which sends the raw PDF as a provider `document` block (`acceptsDocumentBytes`) —
the vision model performs the document-read natively; no separate Textract/GCP-OCR service,
no page rasterization needed at MVP. Recorded per the ticket's substitution clause.

**Stage A vs Stage B:** everything above is deterministic/local and PR-able. Stage B
(D-P1.15-1) is the live leg: `pulumi up` (new env vars + invoker/bucket/Job/secret grants),
a real Substack archive discover→confirm→fetch, one export-zip import, one priced
visual-PDF reconstruction — operator-gated, hard-capped at **$5**.

**Spend this run: $0** — no deploy, no live model call, no live fetch.
